newsitem.title: UK: Europe cotton trade unflustered by falling futures.
newsitem.headline: Europe cotton trade unflustered by falling futures.

text.p: Six days of successively weaker New York cotton futures failed to elicit a response from the European cash markets, according to industry sources.
Business was strictly routine. Central Asian descriptions were bought for nearby delivery to fill unexpected inventory gaps.
Portuguese buyers looked to West Africa and several sources reported firm trades in selected styles.

Latest figures for Portuguese cotton imports released last week put West Africa's share of the 128,242 tonnes bought in the first nine months of 1996 at around 39 percent, making it the biggest source.
